notes.title: Last Update
notes.content:
Last Update!
- Slightly changed attack speeds.
- Re-tested for as best gameplay experience as possible and number of enemies changed accordingly.
- Upgraded visual backgrounds.

This is last update of this game. Please, if you like it and want a sequel, buy it, enjoy it and support us in this way.
Thank you all!

tags.balance_change: - Re-tested for as best gameplay experience as possible and number of enemies changed accordingly.

notes.title: Oracle Trials 1.6
notes.content:
New version of Oracle Trials is here!
What was improved:
- Leonidas, mostly. He can now make quick step back and is faster in fights.
- Leonidas can now hurt only enemies he is facing, which was not previously the case and felt unrealistic.
- New weapon added! Leonidas can cast slings every 3s, which adds more flavour to fights.

notes.title: Lighting and Shadows Update to ver. 1.2
notes.content:
The new update to version 1.2 is here. It is called Lighting and Shadows. What is new / changed?
- New visuals! All levels were added special shaders enabling the lights and shadows to be visible in them.
- Our main hero, Leonidas, was changed as well. Now, he has shining armour consisting of the ancient Spartan war helmet and the shield with Medusa head depicted on it.
- Every attack move now depletes the stamina, which recovers automatically with passing time. This prevents furious clicking and forces the player to think more and plan ahead during the combat situations. 
- Enemy's AI was slightly modified to improve their behaviour during combat.
- In-game background music was improved with game situation reflection: Burning fires.

notes.title: Mac OS support and controls extension
notes.content:
[b]Oracle Trials 1.1[/b]
- Added support for Mac.
- Added possibility to hit ENTER to attack (so during the gameplay, no mouse is needed, e.g. if you play on laptop) - of course, you can still attack with right mouse button too.
- Level 9 spiked hazards falling from the lower red rooftop - removed glitch. 
- Termeno Studios logo added to the menu.
